title: Function Flow Canvas
job: Help engineers onboarding to an unfamiliar service follow one request path across functions, files, and types without opening an unbounded set of editor tabs.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI using an installed language server to emit one self-contained HTML canvas for a selected symbol: inbound/outbound calls, type hops, source snippets, and collapsible depth.
constraints: Use only language servers already installed
Exclude generated and vendor paths by default
Never send source code to a service
